news.headline: Crusoe reportedly raises $3B at a  $30B valuation
news.summary: Crusoe Energy, a data center developer focused on AI infrastructure, has secured a massive $13B contract with trading firm Jane Street, fueling a reported $3B funding round at a $30B valuation. The deal underscores surging demand for compute capacity as AI adoption accelerates across enterprise and financial services.

news.headline: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
news.summary: Thinking Machines is in talks with Accel to raise $1B at a $40B valuation, according to reports. The AI startup is already running at over $100M in annual revenue, signaling strong commercial traction ahead of what could be a major funding round.

educational.title: The Emergency Fund Rule Nobody Follows (But Should)
points: An emergency fund is 3-6 months of essential expenses, kept in cash, not invested
It's not for vacations — it's for job loss, medical bills, or a broken car
Without one, a single bad month can force you into high-interest debt
Keep it boring: a high-yield savings account, not the stock market
Build it before investing aggressively — it's the foundation everything else sits on
